messages.subject: directlabels 2.x support for ggplot2
parts:
This weekend I implemented several new features in the directlabels package, including full support for ggplot2. The directlabels package provides the direct.label(p) function, which takes a ggplot object p and adds direct labels for the colour aesthetic. This plot labeling strategy is often much easier to read than a legend, since the data is used to calculate the label positions. Furthermore, the new version of directlabels includes sophisticated, readable labeling strategies that avoid overlap between data points and other labels. To get started with the directlabels package, have a look at the documentation website

http://directlabels.r-forge.r-project.org/

install.packages("directlabels")
library(ggplot2)
p <- qplot(Petal.Length,Sepal.Length,data=iris,colour=Species)
library(directlabels)
direct.label(p)

Please send me an email if you use directlabels or have ideas to contribute, thanks!
